newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Wing Tiek Manila unit 9-mth net loss.
newsitem.headline: Wing Tiek Manila unit 9-mth net loss.

text.p: National Steel Corp, the Philippine steel manufacturing unit of Malaysia's Wing Tiek Bhd, reported on Monday it made a net loss of 127 million pesos in thefirst nine months of 1996.
The company did not give comparative figures for the same period in 1995 but it said its net profit for full year 1995 was 587.410 million pesos on net sales of 12.515 billion pesos.
The company's unaudited financial statement submitted to the Securities and Exchange Commission showed its nine-month net sales at 9.398 billion pesos.
Cost of goods sold amounted to 9.071 billion pesos, resulting in a gross profit of 326.824 million pesos.
Operating expenses of 525.793 million pesos erased the gross profit, yielding a loss from operations of 198.969 million pesos.
The company did not give further explanation on its financial performance.

National Steel is owned 75.45 percent by Wing Tiek. The other shareholders are the Philippine government's National Development Co with a stake of 18.24 percent; and Japan's Marubeni Corp, 6.31 percent.
The formerly Philippine government-owned National Steel was taken over by Wing Tiek last month.
